verdict.rationale: AngelList's own docs list an Open Cap Table Format (OCF) export of the cap table and many Excel-exportable reports. They also describe a supported transition path to other cap table providers (J.P. Morgan, Pulley), and community users report a self-serve account deletion flow. Together these cover open-format export and leaving for the core equity data. missing for 10: evidence of a complete export of ALL data (uploaded legal documents, board consents, signed grants, fund/investor-side data) in open formats, and independent hands-on corroboration that the OCF export is complete and portable.
